lines: No water, no one… she said: He won't abandon us.
The mother asked: Has Allah commanded you to do this? He said: yes. She said: Then He will not neglect us.
Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, prayed: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley, near Your sacred House.
And water came... Zamzam, still flowing today.
When Allah commands it, He will not neglect you.

beats.text: No water, no one… she said: He won't abandon us.
beats.ur: نہ پانی، نہ لوگ… اور انہوں نے کہا: وہ ہمیں ضائع نہیں کرے گا

beats.text: “Has Allah commanded you?” “Yes.” “Then He will not neglect us.”
beats.ur: کیا اللہ نے آپ کو یہ حکم دیا ہے؟ ہاں۔ تو پھر وہ ہمیں ضائع نہیں کرے گا

beats.en: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House

beats.text: Water from the ground… Zamzam, still flowing today.
beats.ur: زمین سے پانی… زمزم، جو آج بھی بہہ رہا ہے

beats.text: When Allah commands it… He will not neglect you.
beats.ur: جب اللہ حکم دے… تو وہ آپ کو ضائع نہیں کرے گا

beats.text: Full movie of Prophet Ibrahim (AS): link below.
beats.ur: حضرت ابراہیم علیہ السلام کی مکمل فلم دیکھیں، لنک نیچے
